notes: Photos: orientation differs - own_shelf spines read bottom-to-top (logos at the image bottom), hospital_1/4 spines read top-to-bottom for the Agent (logo at the image top). Corners are in original full-res pixels (own_shelf 960x1280, hospital 3024x4032), ordered TL, TR, BR, BL of the visible spine face (hospital cartons lean 5-17 degrees, so the quads are parallelograms). Each exemplar has an overlay check image in the scratch dir (overlay_check). Estimated precision about +/-10-20 px own_shelf, +/-20-40 px hospital. Spine_long_px = mean of left and right edge lengths; spine_short_px = mean of top and bottom edge lengths (horizontal width of the leaning spine, includes some foreshortening). Scale on own_shelf: 2.74 px/mm along the spine from the 5 measured cartons (range 2.69-2.82) and ~3.0 px/mm across. Hospital estimates are transferred from the Agent in hospital_4 or by relative pitch/length and are low confidence because shelves sit at different depths. hospital_1 contains Agent only as the green ends of the top row (label 50805 Agent DEB) - no usable scale. hospital_0 has no measured carton; dims are inferred from catheter length (100 cm Heartrail, 75 cm Conquest). Not catalogued: hospital_0 right bin small boxes (partly Heartrail II 6F), top-right white boxes, a paper note 'Elutax 3 (DCB) 5080323' in hospital_1, and unlabelled items behind the shelf in own_shelf (white pouches, blue towel). Classification doubts: iVascular essential pro (SC vs NC), Meril NEXGEN, Chroma and AVANTIGARD (assumed DES from sizes), Sapphire 3 (SC vs NC).
